def rotl8(x: uint8, k: int) -> uint8:
    """Rotate x left by k bits (0 <= k <= 7); the high bits wrap around to the low end."""
    pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
    post bits.count_ones(out) == bits.count_ones(x)
    ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
    ex rotl8(1, 7) == 128
    ex rotl8(90, 0) == 90
    ex rotl8(255, 4) == 255
    v = int(x)
    r = ((v << k) | (v >> (8 - k))) & 255
    return wrap_as[uint8](r)
